# Qt

> Qt is a comprehensive cross-platform development ecosystem providing frameworks, IDEs, design tools, and quality assurance solutions for building scalable software across desktop, mobile, embedded, and automotive platforms.

Qt offers an integrated suite of products spanning the entire software development lifecycle, from UI design and application development to testing and code quality analysis. The platform emphasizes cross-platform compatibility, embedded systems support, and safety-critical application development.

## Key Topics

- Qt Framework
- QML
- C++
- Qt Creator IDE
- Qt Design Studio
- Cross-platform development
- Embedded systems
- Qt for MCUs
- Squish GUI testing
- Axivion static analysis
- Quality assurance
- Automotive HMI
- Functional safety
- UI design tools
- Test automation

## Core Products & Frameworks

- [Qt | Tools for Each Stage of Software Development Lifecycle](https://www.qt.io): Qt homepage showcasing tools for all software development lifecycle stages.
- [Qt Products | Design, Develop & Deploy Cross-Platform UIs](https://www.qt.io/development): Main Qt products page covering Framework, Creator IDE, Design Studio.
- [Qt Framework – Build Fast, Scalable Cross-Platform Software | Qt](https://www.qt.io/development/qt-framework): Qt Framework product page with APIs, QML, and cross-platform capabilities.
- [Qt for MCUs | Design & Develop Applications for Microcontrollers](https://www.qt.io/development/develop-software-microcontrollers-mcu): Qt for MCUs product page for embedded microcontroller development.
- [Qt Framework – Build Fast, Scalable Cross-Platform Software | Qt](https://www.qt.io/development/develop-embedded-devices): Qt Framework for embedded devices with IoT and automotive focus.

## Development Tools & IDEs

- [Qt Development Tools & IDE Support | Qt Creator & More](https://www.qt.io/development/tools): Overview of Qt development tools including Creator IDE and integrations.
- [Qt Creator IDE – The Professional IDE for Qt Development](https://www.qt.io/development/tools/qt-creator-ide): Qt Creator IDE product page with QML, C++, and AI assistance features.
- [Qt Design Studio - UI Development Tool for Applications & Devices](https://www.qt.io/development/ui-design-tools): Qt Design Studio product page for 2D/3D UI design and QML export.
- [Figma to Qt - GUI Design for Embedded Systems](https://www.qt.io/development/gui-design-figma): Figma to Qt plugin for converting designs to embedded device GUIs.

## Application Development Solutions

- [Desktop, Mobile, XR & Web App Development Tools | Qt](https://www.qt.io/development/application-development): Qt tools for desktop, mobile, XR, and web application development.
- [Qt for Automotive HMI Development in Software-Defined Vehicles](https://www.qt.io/development/qt-in-automotive): Qt tools for automotive HMI development and software-defined vehicles.
- [Qt + IAR | Embedded Development Tools | Qt Group](https://www.qt.io/qt-and-iar): Qt and IAR partnership for embedded development and functional safety.

## Quality Assurance & Testing

- [QA Software & Tools | Qt Quality Assurance](https://www.qt.io/quality-assurance): Qt quality assurance tools: Squish, Coco, Test Center, Axivion.
- [Squish GUI Testing | Automate Cross-Platform GUI Tests Fast](https://www.qt.io/quality-assurance/squish): Squish GUI test automation tool for desktop, web, and embedded apps.
- [Coco: The Code Coverage Analysis Tool for Embedded Devices](https://www.qt.io/quality-assurance/coco): Coco code coverage analysis tool for Qt projects and embedded devices.
- [Test Center for Test Results Management | Quality Assurance](https://www.qt.io/quality-assurance/test-center): Test Center centralized test result management and automation platform.

## Code Quality & Static Analysis

- [Axivion Static Code Analysis: Premier static analyzer](https://www.qt.io/quality-assurance/axivion-static-code-analysis): Axivion static code analysis for C/C++ compliance and code quality.
- [Software Architecture Verification | Axivion](https://www.qt.io/quality-assurance/axivion-architecture-verification): Axivion architecture verification for safety-critical software systems.
- [CUDA Code Verification for Safety-Critical Systems | Axivion](https://www.qt.io/quality-assurance/axivion-for-cuda): Axivion CUDA code verification for NVIDIA safety-critical systems.

## Optional

- [QA Licensing | Choose the Right License for Your Testing Needs](https://www.qt.io/quality-assurance/licensing): QA licensing options for Squish, Coco, Test Center, and Axivion.
